Во-первых, для начала пролистайте весь список ачивментов, поскольку игра заставит вас ресетить прогресс, а именно все уровни, если вы не проходите обучение, а сразу залетаете в самое пекло. Теперь о главном. 
[list]
    [*]Во-первых, держитесь по центру экрана. Да, в игре есть, если мне не изменяет память, второй уровень, который можно запросто проскипать, находясь где-то в углу экрана, но вам необходимо как можно раньше научиться уворачиваться от препятствий. Для этого уже буквально мышечную память вы должны натренировать находиться в центре экрана, легонько тапая в противоположную от препятствия сторону. Чем дальше в лес, тем больше ограничений на вас будут накладывать по сторонам, чтобы вы не выходили за пределы созданных игрой тоннелей. Поэтому просто до упора увернуться влево у вас не выйдет. Тренируйтесь именно небольшими кликами быстро перемещаться по экрану. Причем частенько игра будет спавнить вам препятствия один за другим, и вы сами себе окажете медвежью услугу, если свернете куда-нибудь резко вправо, где вас будет сразу же поджидать следующий объект, от которого вы уклониться  уже не успеете. Была в таких ситуациях тонну раз. Держитесь как можно ближе к центру!
    [*]Во-вторых, не издевайтесь над собой. Многие объекты в игре имеют определенный паттерн расположения, например, вверх-вверх-влево-вниз и т.д. Это всё запросто можно запомнить, натренировав свою мышечную память. Но, как это обычно бывает, любой информации нужно время, чтобы закрепиться, будь то память мышечная или хомяковая, а потому делайте в случае чего перерывы, день-два. Да хоть неделю! Восемь лет, как у меня, перерыв делать необязательно :D Но отдохнуть и закрепить выученное ручками вам нужно. Сами потом почувствуете, как легко вам будет даваться то, что вчера казалось невыносимым.
    [*]Более того, игру "проходить" повторно я начала где-то месяцев 7 назад, тогда уле=еле набрала 30 секунд на 4м уровне. Зайдя сегодня же, вполне легко давалось набирать под 20-30 секунд, так что руки помнят. Руке воевале 2017-2025 можем повторить!1! Не бойтесь делать перерывы между игрой. Если удовольствия и азарта вы уже не получаете, и просто раздраженно продолжаете умирать (копите 666 смертей :D), просто выходите из игры и не измывайтесь над собой. Вы должны так или иначе кайфовать от процесса. Ваши мышцы должны быть расслабленны, это база для любой игры.
    [*]Сконцентрируйтесь полностью на игре, отбросив все мысли в сторону. Не знаю, как у вас, но я никогда не обращала внимания на таймер. Если вы подобным грешите, срочно избавляйтесь от данной привычки! Во-первых, таймер и прочая лабуда будут вас только отвлекать; во-вторых, увидев, что вы приближаетесь к отметке в 60 секунд, вы начнете нервничать, боясь испоганить себе всё, ваш разум заполонят тысячи мелких и колких как иглы тревожных мыслей, и под их влиянием вы точно себе всё испоганите. A wildly inconsistent rage bait simulator

What I will say about this game is you get what you paid for. Four levels for $2 is kinda rough, but there's trading cards and you pop achievements like they're candy, so it balances itself out. I've only spent around a half an hour on it as of writing and I feel confident that I could 100% this game in less than five.

It feels silly saying this for an obscure indie project that's over eight years old at this point, but there's several places where the game could be improved. The game's visuals and gameplay remind me a lot of a non-VR Beat Saber, with the caveat that you need to avoid the things coming at you rather than hitting them. It feels like a rhythm game in that sense...but it's not really a rhythm game. There's no mechanic for timing your button presses to the song or anything like that, when it really feels like there should be. That, and the chiptune music kind of got on my nerves after a while.

I guess I just wish there was more here. I think the premise and gameplay are solid enough as is, but outside of the achievements there's nothing that really grabs me about it, nothing that sucks me in and makes me want more the way other abstract "infinite" games like Tetris do. At $2 I'm not complaining (and even then I'm pretty sure I got this on sale, this is one of those games that I'm sure has been languishing in my Steam library for years), but I wish the game did a little bit more with its concept. I think there's potential in a sequel.

[h1]Reseña de \Linea, the Game\: ¡Más Líneas que en la Mano de un Quiromante![/h1]

[h2]Resumen[/h2]
¡Bienvenidos a \Linea, the Game\, donde tus destrezas para seguir líneas serán puestas a prueba tanto como tu paciencia! ¿Quién pensaría que un mundo hecho completamente de líneas y más líneas podría acabar siendo algo que te mantenga pegado al monitor intentando no cruzarlas como si tu vida dependiera de ello? Si te gustan los juegos minimalistas y estás cansado de tanto brillo en otros títulos, ¡este podría ser tu nuevo vicio!

[h2]Aspectos importantes e interesantes[/h2]
Vamos a hablar claro, este juego es un demonio vestido de simplicidad. Lo que comienza como un tranquilo paseo por un parque de líneas rectas, rápidamente se transforma en un desafío tortuoso y adictivo. Su estética minimalista no es sólo un estilo, es una declaración de principios: aquí, cada pixel cuenta. Además, la banda sonora es hipnótica, como para dejarte en trance mientras fallas una y otra vez. ¡Es lo más cercano a meditar mientras te tiras de los pelos!

[h2]Aspectos por mejorar[/h2]
Todo no puede ser líneas y felicidad, ¿verdad? En primer lugar, si eres del tipo que necesita explosiones o diálogos profundos cada dos minutos, puede que \Linea, the Game\ te sepa a poco. También podemos decir que en ocasiones, la dificultad puede sentirse más como una trampa cruel que como un desafío justo. Más \checkpoints\ no estarían de más, a menos que quieras presenciar el crujir de los controles bajo la presión de tus frustradas manitas.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

Linea, the Game is more Russian Unity low effort/minimum viable product shovelware.  The game here is so basic I had to go look and see if this was an asset flip.  It certainly is shallow and simple enough it could have been an asset pack/demo, it's indistinguishable from one.

This is basically an endless/tunnel runner where you press WASD to dodge red lines that come up at you (or you move towards them, it's hard to tell because the developer didn't bother with any detail here, because this is a simple Russian cash grab).  It's incredibly shallow, on par with Hexcells etc, might as well be a mobile app. 

From a technical perspective, the game doesn't meet basic minimum requirements that most PC gamers expect as standard.

The game features lazy minimalist/untextured low-polygon "retro" assets and visuals, making this look like a barely functional 3D game from the early 1990s.  The lack of textures is a method that lazy devs often use to disguise their lack of talent/interest in doing the graphics properly and trying to disguise it under the name of "art", or "We made it look bad on purpose", which really isn't something gamers should have to put up with.  It's unclear why the developers weren't willing to arrange high quality, high polygon count contemporary assets and high resolution textures for the game.  It looks bad as a result of their decisions, and that's just another reason to avoid it.

The controls can't be customised, which will be an annoyance for many, but it can also render the game unplayable for differently-abled gamers.

These technical defects push this game below acceptable standards for any modern PC game.

Linea, the Game didn't appeal much to the people who own a copy of the game, either.  It has achievements, and they show us a very clear picture that the game didn't really capture any interest from gamers.  The most commonly and easily attained achievement is for starting the game, but less than 18 percent of players bothered to do that far before uninstalling the game.  Hardly a success story, gamers just weren't all that interested in the game.

Reviewing SteamDB to check how popular this game was with players reveals a surprise... there's a very healthy spike in player counts for the game.  But this isn't consistent with the achievement stats, that show only 18 percent of players bothered launching the game.  How is it possible for this game to have so many concurrent players who weren't even playing the game?  Trading cards.  Players will use card idling software to collect the cards and sell them, but this won't trigger any achievements in-game.  That tells us people only really bought this game for trading cards, and that's a damning indictment of the woeful quality.  A closer look at the numbers shows the game just has a couple of players every week running up the game and idling it for cards, then deleting it.  We must ask how it benefits gamers for there to be so many games like this, with no merit as a serious game, that only generate sales from people idling and selling the trading cards.

Linea, the Game is relatively cheap at $2 USD, but it's not worth it. Given the defects and quality issues with the game, coupled with the unrealistic price, this is impossible to recommend.

Oyunun amacı, bitpop müziklerini dinlerken platformlardan ve nesnelerden kaçarak her seviyede en az 60 saniye boyunca hayatta kalmaktır. Oyun, her biri kendi zorluğuna, tasarımına ve müziğine sahip dört benzersiz seviyeye sahiptir.

Oyun zorludur ve engellerden kaçınmak ve mümkün olduğunca uzun süre hayatta kalmak için hızlı tepki süresi gerektirir. Seviyeler, oyunun genel çekiciliğine katkıda bulunan canlı renkler ve akılda kalıcı film müzikleri ile iyi tasarlanmıştır.

Dört seviyeye ek olarak, oyunda oyuncuların en yüksek skor için birbirleriyle yarışabilecekleri çevrimiçi liderlik tabloları da bulunuyor. Yedi gizli başarı da dahil olmak üzere 20'den fazla başarının kilidini açarak oyuncuların daha fazla mücadele etmesini sağlayabilirsiniz.

Linea, the Game ayrıca oyuna koleksiyon değeri katan Steam takas kartlarını da içeriyor. Oyunun basit ama bağımlılık yaratan oynanışı ve akılda kalıcı müzikleri, hızlı ve eğlenceli bir arcade oyunu arayan oyuncular için keyifli bir deneyim sunuyor. Genel olarak Linea, the Game göz atmaya değer, iyi tasarlanmış ve eğlenceli bir oyundur.

首先从核心玩法的角度来看标榜的动作冒险元素并没有得到有效的实现。游戏中的关卡设计看似简洁，实则重复度过高，缺乏足够的创新和挑战性。控制手感僵硬，响应迟钝，常常让人感到挫败而非成就感。尽管线条构成的世界具有一定的艺术美感，但这种美感无法弥补游戏玩法上的贫瘠和单调。

其次游戏的故事叙述并不连贯，玩家在游戏中很难找到明确的目标或情感寄托。剧情线索稀疏，角色缺乏深度，以至于玩家难以建立起与游戏角色及世界的联系。即便游戏试图通过极简的线条美学传达某种深层次的主题，但由于叙事的薄弱，这一意图并未得到有效传达。

再者技术层面的表现也有待改进。游戏在运行过程中偶有卡顿现象，特别是在复杂的场景切换时，帧数下降明显。另外，音频设计相对平淡，背景音乐和音效未能为游戏增添更多氛围，反而有时显得突兀和不合时宜。

最后，考虑到定价与其提供的游戏内容相比，性价比不高。游戏长度较短，缺乏足够的重玩价值，而且更新频率较低，没有看到针对早期用户反馈进行及时优化和增加内容的迹象。

综上所述，虽然在视觉艺术风格上有其独特之处，但在游戏性、故事性和技术表现等方面存在的不足使其难以在众多优秀作品中脱颖而出。对于那些追求丰富游戏体验和深度剧情的玩家来说，这款游戏恐怕难以满足其期待。
